rationale: Independently read the actual inspection helpers and callers. Constant-pool ordering/cardinality/placement, exact opcode sequence/equality, physical MOVE numbering and SETLIST instruction count are implementation choices. Public dump bytes make such choices observable, but neither binary interoperability nor the public dump contract mandates this C compiler optimization sequence. The current v1 proposal must not describe them as unobservable. Retain actual compilation of every supplied closure and source, all load boundaries and diagnostic assertions, all checkR executions/types, all checkK/checkI/checkF/checkints values, binary round trips and original final completion. Some opcode-only functions intentionally error or loop indefinitely: do not indiscriminately execute them as invented semantic requirements.
required_revisions: Author current V3 source-only children and explicit original-anchor/retained-semantic decomposition; do not install dated V1 unobservable records.
Obtain separate independent exact source/exclusion decisions and exact transform review bound to the resulting policy and current retention contracts.
Preserve all original call sites, compilation, checkR and ordinary assertions; no fake listk/listcode facade, T omission, executable exclusion replacement or parent completion.
Require fresh original C and approved Ada instrumented file execution, actual paired/named public witnesses, balanced cleanup and final immutable context reconciliation.
limitations: No exclusion, transform or original-anchor resolution is installed by this feature/validator review.
No component or synthetic observation is imported as runtime or whole-target acceptance.
Current implementation bindings do not transfer to future validator/compiler changes automatically.
